reference_method: the exit code of each block's process; the block text itself is the reference and is hashed into the record so that a changed block invalidates it

observables.name: block_status

observables.name: runnable_blocks_sha256

observables.name: interpreter_location

acceptance_limits.isolation: every interpreter's torchfdtd.__file__ lies inside its sys.prefix and outside the checkout
